findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed window is the score-clock interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity label is present in the supplied observations.

Continuous contrast functions are reported only over the observed support with extrapolation disallowed and observed-node linear interpolation; the inspected landmark features show multiple sign changes (4 to 10) and strong sign conflicts (1 to 9), so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule would be descriptive rather than a validated fit.

The inspected continuous trends are coordinate features of the predicted endpoint world representation, not physical interaction energies or trajectory velocities; their first/last rate z-values are large but the whole-window z-values are small and mixed in sign, so they do not establish a monotone coordinate reward direction.

hypotheses.falsifier: a validated fit or observed-node interpolation showing no sign change or no improvement over a constant rule
hypotheses.observable: landmark local coordinate contrast at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast over the observed window could express a sign-changing landmark feature, but the supplied evidence does not validate a specific time-conditioned rule against a constant rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: decoded terminal labels showing agreement between selection enrichment and final affinity benefit
hypotheses.observable: selection-node contrast versus descendant survival credit
hypotheses.scope: observed selection nodes and complete observed window
hypotheses.statement: Selection enrichment at observed nodes may differ from descendant survival or quality credit, but no decoded terminal labels are supplied, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or outcome evaluation data are supplied, so final affinity benefit and the selection-versus-survival comparison are unavailable.

Only six of 200 continuous_trends rows were inspected; the remaining features, branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects and turnover_accounting tables were not read.
No covariance, intact-conformation or mode diagnostics were read, so coherent joint coordinate patterns versus isolated marginals cannot be assessed.
No parent-child increment contrasts or turnover residual were read, so within-path change versus changing cohort composition cannot be distinguished.
The supplied evidence does not permit a concrete uncertainty- and multiplicity-adjusted priority decision that differs from ranking point estimates alone.
